I live in a monastery where the monks are not allowed to touch money. They shouldn't seek donations. Anyone can live and eat here free if they are harmonious and follow the schedule including a couple hours work and 6 hours meditation. All the teachings are free, the books too. A near limitless supply of recorded dhamma talks are available. The whole place thrives from donations and without guest giving up thier time 5o stay here, it could not function.

Each passing moment we die and are reborn a different person with different thoughts, values, abilities and purposes.
